designSystem.styleGuidelines:
## Brand & Style

This design system is engineered for developers, data analysts, and power users who live inside dark editors and high-density technical workspaces. It evokes a focused, utilitarian, and uncompromisingly precise emotional response—reminiscent of a professional development environment or a high-end mathematical notebook.

The chosen aesthetic is a refined, flat **Dark/Minimalist** style. It completely eschews trendy glassmorphism, organic gradients, and platform-native chrome in favor of absolute visual consistency across all operating systems. Surfaces rely on structured neutral graphite tones paired with crisp white figures and a single, high-visibility amber accent that commands attention without causing eye strain.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout model relies on a fixed-density grid structure optimized for desktop workstations, analytical tools, and high-resolution tablets. Content compartments are organized into rigid structural panes rather than fluid, reflowing cards.

- **Gutters & Margins:** Standardized 16px (`1rem`) architectural spacing ensures consistent alignment between inspector panels, toolbars, and sheet views.
- **Rhythm:** Component paddings and interior element gaps adhere strictly to a 4px/8px baseline grid (`space-xs` through `space-lg`), minimizing wasted canvas space and emphasizing operational efficiency.

## Elevation & Depth

Depth is handled with absolute restraint. The environment is predominantly flat, utilizing sharp structural hairlines (`#2e3034` and `#44464c`) instead of shadows to bound panels, cards, and data grids. 

- **Surface Tiers:** Hierarchy is communicated purely through tonal stacking—stepping from page backgrounds (`#161618`) to sheet surfaces (`#1d1e21`) and raised hover states (`#26272b`).
- **Floating Elements:** Dropdowns, floating menus, and modal dialogs are the sole exceptions, utilizing a single, soft, non-distractive shadow (`0 4px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12)`) to lift them cleanly above the workspace.

## Components

Components are engineered to look and behave identically across Linux, macOS, Windows, web, and iPad.

- **Toolbars:** Composed of icon-above-label buttons (64px width) organized into logical groups separated by thin vertical hairlines. Hover states apply the raised surface color, while active states engage the amber accent tint.
- **Formula Bar:** Features a dedicated cell reference box, an explicit `"fx"` label, a monospace input field, and immediate cancel/accept action controls.
- **Data Grids:** Built with a 48px row-number gutter, column headers housing type badges (`#`, `$`, `Aa`, calendar), and microscopic distribution histograms. Body rows are locked to a dense 28px height with explicit hairlines, a 2px amber accent ring for selected cells, and secondary tinting for active columns.
- **Inspector:** A fixed 300px right-hand panel featuring top-level navigation tabs, uppercase section titles, flat dropdowns, segmented controls, steppers, and switches.
- **Sheet Tabs:** Positioned at the bottom-left in a classic spreadsheet format. Active tabs rest on the surface color with a distinct 2px amber top border, accompanied by an inline add (`+`) control.
- **Status Bar:** A 26px utility bar featuring monospace metrics including row counts, selection aggregates (sum, average, count), GPU identification, and last computation timestamps.
- **KPI Cards:** Composed of a categorical label, large monospace figures, an embedded sparkline, and directional delta chips utilizing semantic good/bad coloring.
- **Charts:** Completely flat visualizations featuring thin gridlines, zero 3D distortion, and rigid adherence to the designated colour-blind-safe series order.

## Colors

The palette is strictly calibrated for dark-mode data density. It utilizes a neutral graphite foundation devoid of blue undertones, establishing a calm backdrop for complex analytical work.

- **Primary & Accent (`#f5a524`):** Warm amber used exclusively for selection rings, primary action states, active tabs, focus states, and critical warnings.
- **Secondary (`#b48cff`):** Muted purple reserved specifically for formula values and secondary data indicators.
- **Neutrals:** A carefully stepped grayscale ranging from deep window chrome (`#121214`) to raised interactive surfaces (`#26272b`), separated by precise hairlines (`#2e3034`).
- **Semantic & Charts:** Dedicated status tones for success (`#3ddc97`) and error (`#ff6b6b`), alongside an eight-color, color-blind-safe categorical palette for data visualization.

## Typography

Typography enforces a strict hierarchy tailored for dense dashboards and spreadsheet interfaces. 

- **UI Interface (`Inter`):** Handles all application chrome, labels, section titles, and page headers. Sizes are kept compact (11px to 20px) to maximize information density.
- **Numbers & Code (`JetBrains Mono`):** Monospace figures are strictly tabular and right-aligned across all data grids, KPIs, status bars, and formula inputs to ensure vertical alignment of numerical data.

## Layout & Spacing

## Shapes

The shape language reflects technical precision. Corner radii are kept minimal to avoid a "soft" or consumer-grade appearance.

- **Panels & Containers:** Panels, cards, and buttons feature a tight `6px` radius.
- **Inputs & Micro-elements:** Inputs, chips, and badges use a crisp `4px` radius.
- **Data Cells:** Table and grid cells strictly utilize `0px` (sharp) corners to maintain clean, uninterrupted grid lines across massive datasets.
- **Icons:** All iconography relies exclusively on Lucide line icons rendered with a `1.5px` stroke weight at a uniform `18px` scale. Emojis are strictly prohibited.

screens.prompt:
Build the desktop interface (1440x900 viewport) for omxplorer on its Report tab according to the Graphite design system specifications and exact prompt requirements:

1. Window Chrome & Navigation:
- Top Title bar: Dark window chrome (#121214) with traffic-light window controls on far left, "omxplorer" in lowercase JetBrains Mono font, and centered "orders.omx" document pill/badge. Right side has kernel status / GPU indicator (e.g. "RTX 4090 · Ready").
- Toolbar: Flat icon-above-label buttons (64px wide, height ~52px) separated into clean groups by vertical hairlines:
  * Group 1: [Open, Save, Undo, Redo]
  * Group 2: [Table, Chart, Pivot, Formula]
  * Group 3: [KPI, Chart tile, Text]
  * Group 4: [Format]
  Hover effects and active tool states with subtle Graphite raised tint and amber accent touch.

2. Inspector Panel (Docked Right, 300px width):
- Border-l hairline (#2e3034), background #1d1e21.
- Top tab bar: "Tile" (active, accent underline/highlight) and "Data".
- Inspector controls:
  * Section header: "TILE CONFIGURATION" (small uppercase 11px)
  * Value column dropdown: "revenue" (with numeric badge '#')
  * Aggregate segmented control: [Sum | Average | Count] (with 'Sum' active/highlighted)
  * Compare-to dropdown: "previous quarter"
  * Display options: Format currency ($), Decimals stepper (1), Show sparkline toggle (checked).
  * Selected Tile indicator: "KPI Tile 1 (Revenue)"

3. Central Work Area:
- Background: #161618 (page behind the sheet).
- Scrollable report document page: Centered white/light or high-contrast crisp card canvas or Graphite document sheet (elevated panel #1d1e21 with hairline #2e3034 border, 6px radius) matching data-science notebook standards. Let's make it the clean report document with title "Q3 orders".
- Header:
  * Page title: "Q3 orders" (20px bold Inter, #ececee)
  * Metadata caption: "Updated just now · 1,000,000 rows · 4.1 ms on the GPU" (with monospace 4.1 ms in JetBrains Mono, GPU badge).
- Filter row (chips):
  * "region = West ✕" (active chip, dark raised pill with subtle amber border/tint)
  * "date: Jul–Sep 2026 ✕" (active chip)
  * "carrier: all" (chip)
  * "+ Filter" (dashed/bordered button)
- KPI Cards row (4 cards in a grid):
  * Card 1: Revenue "$18.4M" in JetBrains Mono bold, delta chip "+4.2%" (good green #3ddc97), mini vector SVG sparkline. SELECTED with 2px amber accent ring (#f5a524) and subtle glow/selection fill.
  * Card 2: Orders "255,102", delta chip "+1.1%" (good green #3ddc97), mini sparkline.
  * Card 3: Average order "$72.06", delta chip "-0.8%" (bad red #ff6b6b), mini sparkline.
  * Card 4: Margin "31.4%", delta chip "+0.6 pts" (good green #3ddc97), mini sparkline.
- Side-by-side Charts section:
  * Chart 1: "Revenue by month" — clean SVG line chart spanning Jan through Sep, with gridlines, gradient fill underneath, and an interactive hover tooltip point at August reading "Aug · $6.3M" with a vertical guide line.
  * Chart 2: "Revenue by carrier" — horizontal bar chart comparing UPS ($7.2M), FedEx ($5.8M), DHL ($3.4M), USPS ($2.0M) with carrier logos/labels, exact JetBrains Mono money values right-aligned.
- Pivot Table:
  * Title: "Revenue · region × product"
  * Formatted matrix table: 5 product columns (Enterprise, Pro, Starter, Hardware, Services) plus "Total" column.
  * Rows for West, East, Central, South, and "Total" row with hairline borders and raised row styling.
  * Numbers right-aligned in tabular JetBrains Mono with currency formatting ($1,240,500 etc.).
- "Add a tile" empty dashed state:
  * Dashed border container with buttons: [ + Sum ], [ + Average ], [ + Count ], [ + Chart ].

4. Bottom Bars:
- Sheet tabs (bottom-left, Excel/Jupyter notebook style): "Orders", "Report" (active tab with #1d1e21 surface and 2px #f5a524 accent top edge), and "+" new tab button.
- Status bar (26px height, monospace metrics): "Filtered: 255,102 of 1,000,000 rows · Sum: $18,421,900 · Avg: $72.06 · NVIDIA RTX 4090 · 4.1 ms"

Ensure full Graphite design system adherence: neutral graphite tones (#121214, #161618, #1d1e21, #26272b), hairline borders (#2e3034), crisp typography (Inter for UI, tabular JetBrains Mono for figures), and warm amber (#f5a524) accents.

outputComponents.text:
Here is the complete desktop design for **omxplorer** (1440×900) on its **Report tab** based on the Graphite design system:

### What was created:
1. **Window Chrome & Toolbar**:
   - macOS traffic light controls with lowercase `omxplorer` branding in JetBrains Mono.
   - Centered `orders.omx` dataset badge and live GPU status badge (`RTX 4090 · Ready`).
   - Grouped icon-above-label toolbar separated by hairline dividers: `[Open, Save, Undo, Redo]`, `[Table, Chart, Pivot, Formula]`, `[KPI, Chart tile, Text]`, and `[Format]`.

2. **Report Workspace & Controls**:
   - Header: `"Q3 orders"` with caption `"Updated just now · 1,000,000 rows · 4.1 ms on GPU"`.
   - Filter bar: Removable chips for `region = West ✕`, `date: Jul–Sep 2026 ✕`, `carrier: all`, and `+ Filter`.
   - Four KPI cards: 
     - **Revenue $18.4M** (`+4.2%`, selected with amber accent ring and sparkline)
     - **Orders 255,102** (`+1.1%`, sparkline)
     - **Average order $72.06** (`-0.8%`, sparkline)
     - **Margin 31.4%** (`+0.6 pts`, sparkline)
   - Side-by-side charts:
     - **Revenue by month**: Line chart with gridlines and interactive hover tooltip pointing at `"Aug · $6.3M"`.
     - **Revenue by carrier**: Horizontal bars comparing UPS Logistics, FedEx Express, DHL Express, and USPS Priority.
   - **Pivot table**: `"Revenue · region × product"` cross-tabulating 5 product columns (`Enterprise`, `Pro Suite`, `Starter`, `Hardware`, `Services`) across regions with row and column totals in tabular JetBrains Mono.
   - **Add a tile row**: Dashed container offering quick action buttons (`+ Sum`, `+ Average`, `+ Count`, `+ Chart`).

3. **300px Inspector & Status Bar**:
   - Docked 300px right-hand inspector panel with active **Tile** tab, value column dropdown (`# revenue`), aggregate segmented control (`Sum / Average / Count`), and comparison selector (`previous quarter`).
   - Bottom sheet tab bar with `Orders`, active `Report` tab (with accent top edge), and `+`.
   - 26px monospace status bar displaying live filtered record count (`Filtered: 255,102 of 1,000,000 rows`), selection aggregates, GPU device, and latency.

  space-xs: 0.25rem
  space-sm: 0.5rem
  space-md: 1rem
  space-lg: 1.5rem
  space-xl: 2rem
---

## Brand & Style

This design system is engineered for developers, data analysts, and power users who live inside dark editors and high-density technical workspaces. It evokes a focused, utilitarian, and uncompromisingly precise emotional response—reminiscent of a professional development environment or a high-end mathematical notebook.

The chosen aesthetic is a refined, flat **Dark/Minimalist** style. It completely eschews trendy glassmorphism, organic gradients, and platform-native chrome in favor of absolute visual consistency across all operating systems. Surfaces rely on structured neutral graphite tones paired with crisp white figures and a single, high-visibility amber accent that commands attention without causing eye strain.

## Colors

The palette is strictly calibrated for dark-mode data density. It utilizes a neutral graphite foundation devoid of blue undertones, establishing a calm backdrop for complex analytical work.

- **Primary & Accent (`#f5a524`):** Warm amber used exclusively for selection rings, primary action states, active tabs, focus states, and critical warnings.
- **Secondary (`#b48cff`):** Muted purple reserved specifically for formula values and secondary data indicators.
- **Neutrals:** A carefully stepped grayscale ranging from deep window chrome (`#121214`) to raised interactive surfaces (`#26272b`), separated by precise hairlines (`#2e3034`).
- **Semantic & Charts:** Dedicated status tones for success (`#3ddc97`) and error (`#ff6b6b`), alongside an eight-color, color-blind-safe categorical palette for data visualization.

## Typography

Typography enforces a strict hierarchy tailored for dense dashboards and spreadsheet interfaces. 

- **UI Interface (`Inter`):** Handles all application chrome, labels, section titles, and page headers. Sizes are kept compact (11px to 20px) to maximize information density.
- **Numbers & Code (`JetBrains Mono`):** Monospace figures are strictly tabular and right-aligned across all data grids, KPIs, status bars, and formula inputs to ensure vertical alignment of numerical data.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout model relies on a fixed-density grid structure optimized for desktop workstations, analytical tools, and high-resolution tablets. Content compartments are organized into rigid structural panes rather than fluid, reflowing cards.

- **Gutters & Margins:** Standardized 16px (`1rem`) architectural spacing ensures consistent alignment between inspector panels, toolbars, and sheet views.
- **Rhythm:** Component paddings and interior element gaps adhere strictly to a 4px/8px baseline grid (`space-xs` through `space-lg`), minimizing wasted canvas space and emphasizing operational efficiency.

## Elevation & Depth

Depth is handled with absolute restraint. The environment is predominantly flat, utilizing sharp structural hairlines (`#2e3034` and `#44464c`) instead of shadows to bound panels, cards, and data grids. 

- **Surface Tiers:** Hierarchy is communicated purely through tonal stacking—stepping from page backgrounds (`#161618`) to sheet surfaces (`#1d1e21`) and raised hover states (`#26272b`).
- **Floating Elements:** Dropdowns, floating menus, and modal dialogs are the sole exceptions, utilizing a single, soft, non-distractive shadow (`0 4px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12)`) to lift them cleanly above the workspace.

## Shapes

The shape language reflects technical precision. Corner radii are kept minimal to avoid a "soft" or consumer-grade appearance.

- **Panels & Containers:** Panels, cards, and buttons feature a tight `6px` radius.
- **Inputs & Micro-elements:** Inputs, chips, and badges use a crisp `4px` radius.
- **Data Cells:** Table and grid cells strictly utilize `0px` (sharp) corners to maintain clean, uninterrupted grid lines across massive datasets.
- **Icons:** All iconography relies exclusively on Lucide line icons rendered with a `1.5px` stroke weight at a uniform `18px` scale. Emojis are strictly prohibited.

## Components

Components are engineered to look and behave identically across Linux, macOS, Windows, web, and iPad.

- **Toolbars:** Composed of icon-above-label buttons (64px width) organized into logical groups separated by thin vertical hairlines. Hover states apply the raised surface color, while active states engage the amber accent tint.
- **Formula Bar:** Features a dedicated cell reference box, an explicit `"fx"` label, a monospace input field, and immediate cancel/accept action controls.
- **Data Grids:** Built with a 48px row-number gutter, column headers housing type badges (`#`, `$`, `Aa`, calendar), and microscopic distribution histograms. Body rows are locked to a dense 28px height with explicit hairlines, a 2px amber accent ring for selected cells, and secondary tinting for active columns.
- **Inspector:** A fixed 300px right-hand panel featuring top-level navigation tabs, uppercase section titles, flat dropdowns, segmented controls, steppers, and switches.
- **Sheet Tabs:** Positioned at the bottom-left in a classic spreadsheet format. Active tabs rest on the surface color with a distinct 2px amber top border, accompanied by an inline add (`+`) control.
- **Status Bar:** A 26px utility bar featuring monospace metrics including row counts, selection aggregates (sum, average, count), GPU identification, and last computation timestamps.
- **KPI Cards:** Composed of a categorical label, large monospace figures, an embedded sparkline, and directional delta chips utilizing semantic good/bad coloring.
- **Charts:** Completely flat visualizations featuring thin gridlines, zero 3D distortion, and rigid adherence to the designated colour-blind-safe series order.
